name: Voxtell Phone
description:
Voxtell AI Phone System is the cloud phone system for Voxtell customers: numbers, call routing, voicemail, teams, and call analytics.

This connector lets Claude answer questions about your phone system in plain language. Ask what happened on the phones today or this week, who called and how long calls lasted, which calls were missed, what a voicemail says, who is on a call right now, how your team compares, where a number routes, and what the number for a contact is.

It is read only. Nothing is changed, sent, or deleted through this plugin, so there is nothing to confirm and nothing to undo. You sign in with your Voxtell username and password on a Voxtell page, plus your authenticator code if your account has one; Claude never sees your password and only receives a revocable connection. Voxtell does not use your data to train AI models.

Requires a Voxtell phone system account. Learn more at https://voxtell.com/integrations/mcp.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Voxtell Phone to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Voxtell Phone to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.voxtell.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Voxtell Phone MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voxtell Phone provides these MCP tools: find_contact, get_account_summary, get_call_details, get_live_calls, get_phone_summary, get_team_analytics, list_calls, list_phone_numbers, list_team, read_voicemails, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Voxtell Phone?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Voxtell Phone in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.

_published_faq.name: Does Voxtell Phone MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Voxtell Phone requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Voxtell Phone is developed by Voxtell. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
